Conquest Lords

Tap your blue castle to upgrade it. Pick a target, choose how many troops to send, then attack. Bigger armies march slower, so split them up! When 80% of the castles are taken, a new island rises from the clouds. A season lasts 5 days: the lord with the most kingdom points wins.
